name: Global Food Services, Inc
old_description: Food Service That Prioritizes Quality, Consistency, and Guest Satisfaction
about:
Global Food Services, Inc. operates from Tampa, Florida, where it runs a food manufacturing and co-packing facility. The company supplies restaurants and other foodservice channels with a focus on healthy, vegetarian items such as dips, sauces, and spices.

Its product portfolio includes the Kasabah line of Mediterranean foods — hummus, falafel, tzatziki, tabouli, and a gluten-free buttermilk pancake mix built on chickpea protein. Beyond its own brand, the company provides co-packing and contract manufacturing for restaurant chains, developing recipes from scratch or reverse-engineering existing menu items, then producing and distributing the finished goods through its own distribution network.

Customers span restaurants, retail outlets, private-label programs, educational institutions, and grocery distributors. The operation is structured to handle everything from recipe formulation to bulk production and delivery, allowing clients to centralize their supply chain.

The company emphasizes an FDA-licensed facility, strict quality-control guidelines, and NDA-protected confidentiality for proprietary recipes. It also promotes bulk purchasing advantages and seamless distribution as ways to reduce costs and maintain consistent flavor across locations.
